title: User Journey Map (Fan)
purpose: Mermaid Journey diagram showing a fan's emotional journey through 8 key milestones from signup through referral, with emotional scoring and friction annotations.
audience: Product managers, UX designers, QA engineers, business stakeholders
description: The fan user journey spans 8 milestones: Signup (score 3), Browse creators (score 3), Subscribe (score 1 — lowest), View Content (score 4), Tip creator (score 2), Message creator (score 4), Enter contest (score 3), Refer friend (score 2). Critical friction points identified: Subscribe has mocked wallet returning fake txHash (real crypto not integrated), Tip has dead Stripe endpoints returning 404, Refer has bonuses calculated but never paid out. Medium friction: View Content watermarking adds load delay and CSS blur is easy to bypass, Message lacks typing indicators and offline delivery, Contest has no audit trail for winner selection. The journey reveals that core monetization flows (Subscribe, Tip) have the worst user experience due to mocked payment infrastructure.

actors.label: Fan
actors.description: End user who discovers, subscribes to, tips, and messages creators on the platform

systems.label: React SPA (Frontend)
systems.description: React single-page application with routing, auth, and UI components

systems.label: Express API (Backend)
systems.description: Express.js REST API with business logic, auth middleware, and database access

systems.label: Supabase Auth
systems.description: Authentication provider for email/password signup, JWT management

systems.label: Mocked Crypto Wallet (useCryptoWallet)
systems.description: Fully mocked wallet integration - hardcoded addresses, fake balance of 1250 USDC, fake 0x0000 txHash

systems.label: Stripe (Legacy/Dead Endpoints)
systems.description: Stripe integration with dead /payments/tip and /payments/unlock-post endpoints returning 404

services.label: Auth Service
services.description: Handles signup, login, JWT token management via Supabase Auth

services.label: User Service
services.description: Profile management, feed generation, gallery operations

services.label: Content Service
services.description: Content CRUD, access control, secure URL generation, watermarking

services.label: Crypto Payment Service
services.description: On-chain transaction verification via eth_getTransactionReceipt, payment recording

services.label: Message Service
services.description: Direct messaging, conversation management, Socket.IO broadcast

services.label: Contest Service
services.description: Contest lifecycle, entry management, winner selection

services.label: Referral Service (Referral Model)
services.description: Referral code generation, validation, bonus milestone checking

services.label: Notification Service
services.description: In-app notification creation and delivery (DB-only, no push)

externalSystems.label: Ethereum RPC (Base Network)
externalSystems.description: Blockchain RPC endpoint for on-chain transaction verification

dataStores.label: Supabase PostgreSQL
dataStores.description: Primary database — profiles, content, subscriptions, transactions, messages, notifications

dataStores.label: Cloudflare R2 Storage
dataStores.description: Object storage for content files, thumbnails, voice messages, verification docs

entryPoints.label: Signup Milestone
entryPoints.description: Fan creates account with email, password, username, and role selection

exitPoints.label: Refer Friend Milestone
exitPoints.description: Fan generates referral code and shares it — final milestone in the journey

preconditions: Fan has valid email and password for signup
Platform is accessible with working frontend and backend
Creators exist on the platform for the fan to interact with
postconditions: Fan is authenticated with JWT stored in localStorage
Fan has subscribed to at least one creator
Fan has viewed, tipped, messaged, entered contests, and referred friends

nodes.label: Signup — Email + password → profile → feed
nodes.description: Fan signup with email/password, role selection, optional referral code. Score: 3. Redirects to feed after completion.

nodes.label: Enter email, password, username
nodes.description: User fills signup form with email, password, username, and selects role (fan)

nodes.label: Backend creates auth user + profile
nodes.description: POST /api/v1/auth/signup — Supabase Auth user created, profile record inserted, referral applied if code provided

nodes.label: JWT stored in localStorage
nodes.description: Frontend stores returned JWT and updates AuthProvider state

nodes.label: Redirected to fan feed
nodes.description: Fan redirected to /fan/feed as role-appropriate landing page

nodes.label: Email already registered (409)
nodes.description: Backend returns 409 — show 'Email already in use'

nodes.label: Username taken (409)
nodes.description: Backend returns 409 — suggest alternative usernames

nodes.label: Browse creators — Search or suggested → view profile
nodes.description: Fan searches or browses suggested creators, views creator profile with content preview and subscription tiers. Score: 3.

nodes.label: Search for creators
nodes.description: Fan uses search or suggested creators list on feed/splash page

nodes.label: View creator profile
nodes.description: Frontend requests GET /api/v1/users/profile/:username — returns profile, content preview, subscription status

nodes.label: Creator not found (404)
nodes.description: Creator username does not exist or account is suspended — show error

nodes.label: Subscribe — Connect wallet → approve USDC → wait
nodes.description: Fan selects tier, connects mocked wallet, approves USDC spend. Score: 1 (worst). Mocked wallet returns fake 0x0000 txHash.

nodes.label: Select subscription tier
nodes.description: Fan browses creator subscription tiers and selects one

nodes.label: Connect wallet (mocked)
nodes.description: useCryptoWallet connects with hardcoded address 0x84f2...78453 or 0x5C3C...5F78, fake balance 1250 USDC

nodes.label: Approve USDC + sign transaction
nodes.description: Fan approves USDC spend and signs contract transaction — wallet returns fake 0x0000 txHash

nodes.label: Backend verifies (or bypasses via sandbox check)
nodes.description: POST /api/v1/payments/crypto/verify — sandbox check (0x0000 prefix) skips on-chain verification, creates subscription

nodes.label: Payment declined / insufficient balance
nodes.description: Mocked flow always succeeds — real failure paths exist but are never triggered

nodes.label: View content — Browse posts → unlock content
nodes.description: Fan browses feed or gallery, clicks locked content, access check runs, signed URL generated. Score: 4. Watermarking adds load delay.

nodes.label: Browse posts in feed/gallery
nodes.description: Fan scrolls through content cards — each shows thumbnail, title, creator name, lock/unlock status

nodes.label: Content access check
nodes.description: Backend checks: is fan subscribed? has fan paid PPV? is fan the creator? 4 exit conditions

nodes.label: Generate signed URL from R2
nodes.description: GET /api/v1/content/:id/secure-url — backend generates time-limited signed URL (3600s default)

nodes.label: Watermark applied (sharp composite)
nodes.description: If photo + not owner: download original from R2, sharp composite SVG @username (tiled, 25% opacity), convert to WebP, upload temp

nodes.label: Content displayed in viewer
nodes.description: Image displayed in ContentViewerModal with zoom/pan, video loaded in player, audio shown with controls

nodes.label: Locked overlay shown (not authorized)
nodes.description: If access denied: show blurred/locked overlay with 'Subscribe to view' or 'Unlock for $X'

nodes.label: Tip creator — Select amount → wallet → approve
nodes.description: Fan selects tip amount, approves in wallet, submits to verify endpoint. Score: 2. Stripe endpoints dead (404).

nodes.label: Select tip amount (preset or custom)
nodes.description: TipModal shows preset amounts and custom input field

nodes.label: Submit transaction hash for verification
nodes.description: POST /api/v1/payments/crypto/verify with txHash, creatorId, amountInCents, transactionType='Tip'

nodes.label: Tip confirmed, creator notified
nodes.description: Transaction recorded, creator receives notification, fan sees confirmation

nodes.label: Stripe tip endpoint returns 404 (dead)
nodes.description: Frontend calls /payments/tip — endpoint does not exist, returns 404

nodes.label: Message creator — Open DM → send → real-time
nodes.description: Fan opens conversation, sends text or voice message delivered via Socket.IO in real-time. Score: 4. No typing indicators or offline delivery.

nodes.label: Open existing or start new conversation
nodes.description: Fan navigates to /fan/messages, selects or creates conversation with creator

nodes.label: Send text/voice message
nodes.description: POST /api/v1/messages with receiverId + text, or POST /api/v1/messages/voice with audio file

nodes.label: Socket.IO real-time message delivery
nodes.description: Backend emits new_message event to conversation room — both parties receive in real-time

nodes.label: Enter contest — View → enter → wait for winner
nodes.description: Fan browses active contest feed, enters eligible contest, awaits winner selection. Score: 3. No winner selection audit trail.

nodes.label: Browse active contest feed
nodes.description: GET /api/v1/contests/feed — returns active contests with title, prize, end date

nodes.label: Enter contest
nodes.description: POST /api/v1/contests/:id/enter — backend checks active status, not ended, not already entered, meets requirements

nodes.label: Entry created, awaiting winner
nodes.description: Contest entry recorded, fan sees 'Successfully entered' confirmation

nodes.label: Entry denied (not subscribed / already entered / ended)
nodes.description: Backend returns 403 (not subscribed), 409 (already entered), or 400 (ended)

nodes.label: Refer friend — Get code → share → friend signs up
nodes.description: Fan generates referral code, shares with friend, friend signs up with code. Score: 2. Bonuses calculated but never paid out.

nodes.label: Generate referral code
nodes.description: POST /api/v1/referrals/generate — creates username-based code

nodes.label: Share referral code
nodes.description: Fan copies link or shares via social media

nodes.label: Friend signs up with referral code
nodes.description: New user enters referral code during signup — backend validates and links referral

nodes.label: Referral bonus calculated but never paid out
nodes.description: Milestone bonus system calculates rewards but no actual payout mechanism disburses them

connections.label: Fan begins browsing creators after signup
Browse starts with search or suggestion
Fan chooses to subscribe after viewing profile
Subscription active, fan can view content
Payment declined (though mocked flow never fails)
Fan browses posts in feed or gallery
Stripe tip path hits dead 404 endpoint
Contest entry starts with browsing feed
Friend signs up with referral code

decisions.condition: Content is photo and not owner?

loops.condition: Fan sends multiple messages in conversation

errorPaths.recovery: Show retry prompt, token never stored
Show payment processing error — try again

validationRules: Password must meet minimum strength requirements
Username must be unique and match alphanumeric pattern
Referral code must exist and be active
Contest entry checks: active status, not ended, not duplicate, subscription requirement met
businessRules: Signup always returns success for password reset (email enumeration prevention)
Mocked wallet always has 1250 USDC balance
Sandbox 0x0000 prefix bypasses on-chain verification entirely
Referral bonus milestones are calculated but never paid out
Content visibility gates access based on subscription/PPV status
securityConsiderations: Mocked wallet 0x0000 sandbox bypass means any authenticated user can create verified transactions without real payment
CSS blur for locked content is trivially bypassable (inspect element)
Stripe dead endpoints return 404 but still expose internal URL structure
No typing indicators or offline delivery in messaging (privacy/UX gap)
performanceConsiderations: Watermarking adds per-view latency (sharp composite + R2 upload + signed URL generation)
Feed loads 20 items per page — may be slow for fans subscribed to many creators (N+1 queries)
AI caption generation takes 1-5 seconds synchronous HTTP wait
annotations: Subscribe: score 1 — mocked wallet returns fake txHash, real crypto wallet not integrated
Tip: score 2 — dead Stripe endpoints 404, crypto flow is mocked
Refer: score 2 — referral bonuses calculated but never paid out
View Content: score 4 — watermarking adds load delay, CSS blur easy to bypass
Message: score 4 — no typing indicators, no offline delivery
Contest: score 3 — no visibility into winner selection, no audit trail
